baseRatesFrom: the 'Base Rate' column of the source doc, taken verbatim; each question's rates sum to 1.000
marketType: categorical (single-select) — MarketFactory.createCategoricalMarket, REALITY_SINGLE_SELECT_TEMPLATE. The options within each question are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, so exactly one wins and price == P(that option). NOT multi-categorical (which normalises payouts across k winners) and NOT multi-scalar (which prices vote share).
note: price is the seeded pool price for each outcome. tag drives the wrapped ERC20 symbol ZNU7<shortName><tag> and must be unique within a question. 'Invalid result' is appended by the factory: it is not listed here, gets no tokenName, and gets no pool.
hazard: The base rates read naturally as vote SHARES (Abstain at 2-4%), but a single-select market resolves to whichever option actually WINS, and Abstain winning a plurality is ~0%. Seeding them verbatim is a deliberate decision taken 2026-09-03. If the intent turns out to be vote share, reprice (fork reseed-zcash-liquidity.js) or rebuild as multi-scalar.
